# PROCESS — iteration cand_0002 (parent cand_0001, val 0.450)

Built on cand_0001 (baggage recompute + cancel guard, both KEPT & untouched — they
fixed 11/37 and broke nothing). This iteration diagnosed THIS iteration's traces and
shipped code-first fixes for new clusters. All guards run against the REAL tau2 DB via
`/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv` before keeping.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause (from traces) | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Extra invalid booking w/ 2 certificates | 12 (2 trials) | agent booked a NEW reservation paid with TWO travel certificates; gold has NO such booking. tau2 API never enforces the payment-mix limit | RULE VIOLATION | in-body guard (code) |
| 2 | Wrong payment method on update | 17 (2 trials) | user "prefers gift card"; agent chose gift_card_6490722 ($127<$209) → bare "balance not enough" → fell back to credit card. Gold uses gift_card_8190333 ($280, sufficient) | RULE/KNOWLEDGE | enriched actionable error (code) |
| 3 | Modified WRONG reservation (route not matched) | 22 (2 trials) | user gave no reservation ID, described "New York → Chicago"; agent grabbed first reservation (UM3OG5 SEA→DFW) instead of FQ8APE (EWR→ORD) | KNOWLEDGE/behavioral | additive prompt rule + worked example |
| 4 | book_reservation payment FORMAT wrong on 1st call | 8, 23 | agent emits [{"type":..,"id":..}] instead of [{"payment_id":..,"amount":..}] → validation error, wasted turn | KNOWLEDGE gap (weak reader) | docstring: exact schema + example |
| 5 | Transfers to human to "send email" | 23(t1), 17 | agent called transfer_to_human_agents for an email request (ends conversation); email is not a tool capability, should just decline | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt rule |
| — | SKIPPED: same-flight-as-before | 8, 25 | needs matching a PAST reservation's flight number (HAT271); compounded w/ format+seat. No safe general fix; also 8 picks wrong flight so no single edit flips it | — | — |
| — | SKIPPED: confirm+STOP atomic | 40 | user says "yes###STOP###" in ONE message → conversation ends BEFORE the agent's post-confirmation write turn. Passing tasks (19) get a separate "yes" then act. Unwinnable without violating the confirmation contract → infra artifact | — | — |

## Edits kept (each REAL + SAFE + VERIFIED)
### tools.py (code)
1. **`book_reservation` payment-mix guard** (cluster 1). Counts sources via new helper
   `_payment_method_source`; raises if >1 certificate / >1 credit card / >3 gift cards.
   - VERIFY: task12 args (2 certs) → raises "Payment mix not allowed (2 travel certificates…)". task23 valid combo (1 cert + 2 gift) → guard SILENT. task8 gold (1 cert) → SILENT. Happy-path 2-pax single-cert book → succeeds (res HATHAT, nonfree 0).
   - BLAST RADIUS: **BOUNDED**. Only over-limit mixes hit it. Passing bookings: 25 uses ≤1 each (t0: cert+credit; t1: gift+credit) → silent; 11/19/37 make no bookings. No passing task changes.
2. **`_payment_for_update` override** (cluster 2). Same success path/deduction as base; on
   insufficient gift card the error now LISTS gift cards with enough balance + credit cards.
   - VERIFY: `_payment_for_update(omar, gift_card_6490722, 209)` → error names `gift_card_8190333` (the $280 gold card) as a sufficient option.
   - BLAST RADIUS: **BOUNDED**. Only changes ERROR TEXT on already-raising paths (not-found / certificate / gift-insufficient); the success branch (deduct + Payment / None-on-zero) is byte-identical. No passing update path (task 12 baggage total_price=0 → returns None) changes.
3. **`book_reservation` insufficient-balance error enriched** (states held vs requested).
   BOUNDED — error text only, already-raising path.
4. **`payment_methods` docstring** rewritten with exact 2-key schema (`payment_id`+`amount`),
   "do NOT use type/id", sum-to-total rule, mix limits, worked example (cluster 4, weak-reader
   KNOWLEDGE). Doc-only → zero behavioral risk.

### policy.md (prompt, additive knowledge only)
5. **"Locating the right reservation when the user gives no reservation ID"** (cluster 3):
   inspect EVERY reservation, match by origin+destination, city→airport map, ask if
   ambiguous. Generic placeholder ids (AAA111/BBB222) in the example — no task literals.
   - BLAST RADIUS: additive; only activates when no reservation ID is given. Passing task 19 (located by "trip to Texas") already matched correctly → rule aligns, action unchanged.
6. **No email/text tool** rule: decline external-message requests, do NOT transfer for them
   (cluster 5). Additive; passing tasks never transfer for email.

## Verify-the-fix lines (one per edit) — see the table above; all run on the real DB.

## Non-overfitting
No task-specific ids/values/dates/answers in code. Guard uses the GENERAL policy predicate
(payment-source counts). Prompt example uses placeholder ids. City→airport map is domain data.

## Process / features used
Serial (single agent) + real-DB simulation of every guard/error on the exact args from
failing AND passing traces. Diagnosis via `tau2_reward_info.action_checks` (= gold writes)
vs the agent's actual tool_calls, extracted with a script over ./trajectories/.

## Preserve
cand_0001's baggage recompute + cancel eligibility guard (untouched). The payment-mix guard's
thresholds (≤1/≤1/≤3) are policy-exact — do not tighten. `_payment_for_update` success path
must stay identical to base.

## Deliberately skipped
40 (confirm+STOP infra artifact — no safe fix). 8/25 (same-flight-as-before matching + 8
also selects the wrong flight; no single general edit flips them). 17's exact payment-card
choice is user-preference-driven — addressed via the enriched error, not a hardcoded card.
